notes.title: July 8 Update
notes.content:
-Slightly adjusted the escape behavior when Rumia (the player) gets stuck in a wall
-Increased the attack power of the Remote-Controlled Rock, Keystone, and the mid-stage rock in Stage 1
-Added new Tips
-Balance adjustments
-Bug fixes

notes.title: June 22 Update
notes.content:
-Added support for the left stick on gamepads
-Added gameplay tips
-Fixed bugs

notes.title: June 21 Update
notes.content:
-Added Tips to the pause screen
-Added invincibility at the end of Rumia's special move
-Made minor adjustments to stage layouts
-Balance adjustments

notes.title: June 11 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where jumping became impossible during slow-motion effects
-Changed Kyoko's Amulet effect so that it can now be overwritten by stacking
-Bug fixes

notes.title: June 9th Update
notes.content:
-Adjusted Rumia's advanced technique, "Lift Jump," to make it easier to perform
-Fixed a bug where Unbreak could get stuck in the ceiling

notes.title: June 7th Update
notes.content: -Fixed a stage that was impossible to complete when playing as Kyoko

notes.title: June 6th Update Part 2
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue where a typo had unintentionally nerfed parrying
-Balance adjustments

notes.title: June 6th Update
notes.content:
-Changed all box-related damage received by the player (Rumia) to 1
-Modified the structure of some stages
-Difficulty adjustments
-Various minor bug fixes

notes.title: June 4th Update
notes.content:
-Adjusted the layout and difficulty of some stages
-Made slight changes to the result screen of the post-clear unlocked mode
-Fixed a bug where Unbreak could get stuck in walls and block progression
-Various other minor adjustments

notes.title: June 1st Update
notes.content:
-Adjusted difficulty, focusing on the EX Area
-Changed terrain-placed instant-death spikes to high-damage spikes
-Fixed a bug where Koishi's Third Eye would stretch infinitely under certain conditions
-Fixed some areas where the background was displaying incorrectly
-Other minor tweaks and adjustments

notes.title: May 28th Update
notes.content:
-Modified the structure of some stages
-Adjusted BGM looping
-Balanced gameplay
-Fixed various bugs

notes.title: May 26th Update
notes.content:
– Removed the feature where Kyoko's sound waves break when solidified inside a wall
– Fixed a bug where falling into a pit on certain stages could cause the player to get stuck and die instantly
– Balance adjustments
– Various other small fixes and tweaks

notes.title: May 24th Update
notes.content:
– Fixed a bug where Kyoko would slide off when attacking on top of a key
– Adjusted enemy Rumia to make it easier for her to throw bombs
– Balance adjustments
– Minor text corrections
– Other bug fixes
